SEON is the command center for fraud prevention and AML compliance, helping thousands of companies worldwide stop fraud, reduce risk and protect revenue. Powered by 900+ real-time, first-party data signals, SEON enriches customer profiles, flags suspicious behavior and streamlines compliance workflows - all from one place. SEON provides richer data, more flexible and transparent analysis, and faster time to value than any other provider on the market. We’ve helped companies reduce fraud by 95% and achieve 32x ROI, and we’re growing fast, thanks to our partnerships with some of the world’s most ambitious digital brands like Revolut, Wise, and Bilt.

We're looking for a Senior Motion Designer who is a strong craft practitioner and an even stronger thinker, someone who can lead creative direction, pressure-test briefs, and build systems, not just produce assets. Motion is the core craft requirement.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead motion design across brand touchpoints — social, digital campaigns, video, and event assets

- Own video editing for digital and content marketing from brief to final delivery

- Develop concepts and storyboards before production starts

- Set and raise the quality bar for motion across the team

- Apply a consistent brand lens, pushing back when a brief would compromise it

- Interrogate briefs from demand gen, content, and field marketing before executing

- Act as a creative partner to stakeholders, not just an executor

- Build tools, templates, and reusable assets that let the team self-serve

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Professional proficiency in English

- Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality motion and brand design

- Advanced proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro

- Strong supporting skills in Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop

- Demonstrable ability to develop a concept, not just execute one

- Several years of senior-level motion design experience in a fast-paced environment (agency or in-house)

- Experience interrogating briefs and proposing creative direction

- Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to varying complexity
